author: nickyeow

english.text: It would be unfair if we treated him so badly.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam2 deoi3 keoi5，hou2 ci5 m4 hai6 gei2 hou2。
text: 我哋噉對佢，好似唔係幾好。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I was watching TV then.

jyutping: ngo5 go2 zan6 hai2 dou6 tai2 gan2 din6 si6。
text: 我嗰陣喺度睇緊電視。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She said to herself, "Where shall I go next?"

jyutping: keoi5 zi6 jin4 zi6 jyu5 gam2 waa6：「ngo5 gan1 zyu6 heoi3 bin1 dou6 hou2 ne1？」
text: 佢自言自語噉話：「我跟住去邊度好呢？」

author: nickyeow

english.text: If you don't watch out, you'll soon fall in the water.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 haang4 lou6 m4 daai3 ngaan5，jat1 zan6 gaan1 nei5 zau6 wui5 dit3 lok6 seoi2 gaa3 laa3。
text: 如果你行路唔帶眼，一陣間你就會跌落水㗎喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Talking of classical music, who is your favorite composer?

jyutping: gong2 hei2 gu2 din2 jam1 ngok6，nei5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 bin1 go3 zok3 kuk1 gaa1 aa3？
text: 講起古典音樂，你最鍾意邊個作曲家呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: My father plays golf every Sunday.

jyutping: ngo5 aa3 baa4 fung4 can1 lai5 baai3 jat6 dou1 wui6 heoi3 daa2 go1 ji5 fu1 kau4。
text: 我阿爸逢親禮拜日都會去打哥爾夫球。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Let's walk on the beach after dinner.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sik6 jyun4 maan5 faan6，bat1 jyu4 heoi3 hoi2 taan1 saan3 bou6 aa1。
text: 我哋食完晚飯，不如去海灘散步吖。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Who cared for the dog when you were away?

jyutping: nei5 zau2 zo2 go2 zan6 bin1 go3 bong1 nei5 tai2 zyu6 zek3 gau2 aa3？
text: 你走咗嗰陣邊個幫你睇住隻狗呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: He played the girl a piece of music of his own writing.

jyutping: keoi5 daan6 zo2 sau2 zi6 gei2 zok3 ge3 go1 bei2 go3 neoi5 zai2 teng1。
text: 佢彈咗首自己作嘅歌比個女仔聽。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I don't like both of you going to such a place.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 nei5 dei6 loeng5 go3 heoi3 maai4 di1 gam2 ge3 dei6 fong1。
text: 我唔鍾意你哋兩個去埋啲噉嘅地方。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Fuck off!

jyutping: sei2 lan2 hoi1 laa1 nei5！
text: 死撚開啦你！

author: nickyeow

english.text: I would like to have a cup of coffee.

jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 bui1 gaa3 fe1。
text: 我想飲杯咖啡。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Let's go by taxi, OK?

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 daap3 dik1 si6 heoi3 laa1，hou2 mou2？
text: 我哋搭的士去啦，好冇？

author: Wezel

english.text: There's no cure for stupidity.

jyutping: jan4 ceon2 mou5 joek6 ji1。
text: 人蠢冇藥醫。

author: kaenif

english.text: Double the dose.

jyutping: gaa1 jat1 pui5 joek6 loeng6。
text: 加一倍藥量。

author: nickyeow

english.text: When I was studying to become a lawyer, my teachers told me to never ask a question that I didn't know the answer to.

jyutping: ngo5 duk6 faat3 leot6 go2 zan6，di1 lou5 si1 gaau3 ngo5 m4 hou2 man6 di1 zi6 gei2 m4 zi1 dou6 daap3 on3 ge3 man6 tai4。
text: 我讀法律嗰陣，啲老師教我唔好問啲自己唔知道答案嘅問題。

author: kaenif

english.text: It's not a wife that I want, but a sex friend.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 soeng2 jiu3 lou5 po4，ngo5 soeng2 wan2 go3 SP zaa3。
text: 我唔係想要老婆，我想搵個SP咋。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I need someone to proofread my essay.

jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 wan2 jan4 gaau3 deoi3 ngo5 pin1 leon6 man4。
text: 我要搵人校對我篇論文。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I wish you were wrong.

jyutping: hei1 mong6 nei5 gong2 ge3 je5 m4 hai6 zan1 gaa3 laa1。
text: 希望你講嘅嘢唔係真㗎啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Hi, is this the Boston Public Library?

jyutping: nei5 hou2 aa3，hai6 mai6 bo1 si6 deon6 gung1 gung6 tou4 syu1 gun2 aa3？
text: 你好呀，係咪波士頓公共圖書館呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I always cry at weddings.

jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 can1 fan1 lai5 dou1 haam3。
text: 我去親婚禮都喊。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Stop changing your mind! A while ago, you said you wanted to go, but now you say you don't want to. Are you really going or aren't you?

jyutping: nei5 zaa1 ding6 zyu2 ji3 hou2 wo3！tau4 sin1 jau6 waa6 heoi3，ji4 gaa1 jau6 waa6 m4 heoi3，gam2 nei5 ze1 hai6 heoi3 ding6 m4 heoi3 aa3？
text: 你揸定主意好喎！頭先又話去，而家又話唔去，噉你啫係去定唔去呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Both sisters are blonde.

jyutping: loeng5 zi2 mui6 dou1 hai6 gam1 tau4 faat3 ge3。
text: 兩姊妹都係金頭髮嘅。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I think Tom will probably be there tonight.

jyutping: aa3 tong1 gam1 maan1 jing1 goi1 hai2 dou6。
text: 阿湯今晚應該喺度。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Japanese like the number 14, which they interpret as meaning "to die alone"; however, the number 24 is not really popular amongst Japanese people. Such numbers are a no-no to Chinese, who think that the number 4 is just unlucky; however, that number is sacred to Japanese. The number 54 is acceptable to speakers of Cantonese, for whom it means "not dead." Chinese prefer the number 3, the "life" or "birth" number. Japanese and Chinese people have different cultures, of course.

jyutping: jat6 bun2 jan4 zung1 ji3 14 hou6，keoi5 dei6 gaai2 sik1 ni1 go3 sou3 zi6 hai6「duk6 zi6 sei2 heoi3」ge3 ji3 si1；daan6 hai6，24 hou6 hai2 jat6 bun2 jan4 dong1 zung1 m4 hai6 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4。ni1 di1 sou3 zi6 deoi3 zung1 gwok3 jan4 lai4 gong2 hai6 m4 ho2 ji5 ge3，jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 gok3 dak1 4 ni1 go3 sou3 zi6 zi2 hai6 m4 hou2 coi2；54 ni1 go3 sou3 zi6 deoi3 gong2 jyut6 jyu5 ge3 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 lai4 gong2 hai6 ho2 ji5 zip3 sau6 ge3，deoi3 gong2 jyut6 jyu5 ge3 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 lai4 gong2，ni1 go3 sou3 zi6 ge3 ji3 si1 hai6「mei6 sei2」。dong1 jin4，jat6 bun2 jan4、hoeng1 gong2 jan4 tung4 zung1 gwok3 jan4 ge3 man4 faa3 m4 tung4。
text: 日本人鍾意14號，佢哋解釋呢個數字係「獨自死去」嘅意思；但係，24號喺日本人當中唔係好受歡迎。呢啲數字對中國人嚟講係唔可以嘅，因為佢哋覺得4呢個數字只係唔好彩；54呢個數字對講粵語嘅香港人嚟講係可以接受嘅，對講粵語嘅香港人嚟講，呢個數字嘅意思係「未死」。當然，日本人、香港人同中國人嘅文化唔同。
